name: shirazeh.http
description: Transfers document files over HTTP for the Shirazeh documentation application.

provides.name: shirazeh.http.service
provides.description: Reads text documents over HTTP. Moves bytes only; it does not interpret document content.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Fetches a text document with GET and returns its body as text. Only same-origin relative URLs are accepted. Network and protocol failures are converted to this plugin's standard error structure before returning; nothing about the transport leaks past this boundary.
methods.returns: Promise<{ status: number, body: string }> on success, or a standard Bonyan error object on failure
